reviews.text:
こちらは初購入です。
ナチュラルな眉は描きやすいと思うけど、わたしの好みではなかった（ ; ; ）
reviews.zh:
呢個係我第一次購買。
我覺得自然嘅眉毛好畫，但係唔係我嘅喜好（；；）

reviews.text: I tend to struggle with overdoing my brows and wanted something beginner friendly, quick to draw for when in a rush and without worrying about overdoing my brows. C3 Modern Beige is a very natural trending colour :)! Colour is easily buildable. Lovely product!
reviews.zh: 我好容易畫過頭眉毛，所以想搵一款啱新手、趕時間嗰陣快速畫又唔怕畫得太重嘅產品。C3 Modern Beige 係一個好自然、好流行嘅顏色 :)！顏色易疊加。好靚嘅產品！

reviews.text: Great product and it's really the true color is really a black gra. It really suits me and it lasts all day. I would recommend.
reviews.zh: 好產品，真正嘅顏色係黑灰色（black gray）。好啱我，全日都持久。我會推薦。

reviews.text: I really like this tone/color for summer because my hair gets natural highlights in the sun. So I find that this is the perfect color. This is my favorite brow formulation. It doesn't smudge even when you are sweating. So please never change the formula Rom&nd or i will cry.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個色調／顏色，用嚟夏天最啱，因為我嘅頭髮曬咗會有天然挑染效果。所以我覺得呢個色啱啱好。呢個係我最鍾意嘅眉部配方。即使流汗都唔會暈開。所以拜託 Rom&nd 千祈唔好改配方，唔係我會喊。

reviews.text:
For people with naturally blonde hair, this product is a great choice for a brow product. I can’t stray from this one. 
Specifically within Korean beauty, this shade of blonde is unique and goes very well with my hair color.
Unlike western brow products for blonds, it’s not ashy, cool toned, or dark.
If you want a brow product to fill in your brows in a natural but clean way, this is the one for you!
reviews.zh:
對於天然金髮嘅人嚟講，呢款眉部產品係好好嘅選擇。我一直都冇轉過用其他。
特別係喺韓國美妝入面，呢種金色調好獨特，同我嘅髮色好夾。
唔似西方為金髮人設計嘅眉部產品，佢唔係灰調、冷調或者深色。
如果你想搵一款眉部產品，可以乾淨、自然咁填補眉毛，咁呢款就係你嘅首選！

reviews.text: This eyebrow pencil has the great texture - neither too soft nor too hard, making it easy to use. It may smudge with strong rubbing, but when set with powder and a fixer, it lasts really well throughout the day.
reviews.zh: 呢枝眉筆質地好好，唔會太軟又唔會太硬，所以好易用。如果大力擦拭都可能會暈開，但係用粉同定妝噴霧定咗妝之後，就可以全日都持久。

reviews.text: My go-to eye brow pencil now. Light grey colour works well with black-ish eye brows. Looks very natural.
reviews.zh: 而家我最常用嘅眉筆。淺灰色同偏黑嘅眉毛好夾，睇落好自然。

reviews.text: Needed a lighter color to use with my browcara. Color seems like a perfect match. Will have to try it on a hot humid day to see the longevity but so far so good.
reviews.zh: 我需要一個淺啲嘅顏色，配我嘅 browcara（眉睫膏）一齊用。顏色睇落好啱。要試吓喺又熱又濕嘅日子用，睇吓持久力點，但係目前都好好。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
